items.title: How confident should you be, and how does that change with more evidence?
items.description: L2's "closed three Mondays running" claim is inductive, not deductive — it never promised certainty. This simplified illustrative model (not a rigorous statistical formula) grows confidence with every consistent Monday checked, but it approaches 100% without ever reaching it — that gap is the actual difference between an inductive conclusion and a deductively valid one. Drag the slider to see how many consistent checks it takes before more evidence stops moving the needle much.
items.compute: const confidence = Math.round((1 - Math.pow(0.5, params.observations)) * 1000) / 10; return { confidence };
